# Add README to project folder

## What we know

- The repo is nearly empty: no commits yet, one tracked artifact under [`.cursor/hooks.json`](.cursor/hooks.json).
- Hooks delegate every listed lifecycle event to [`/Users/jamie/bin/hook`](/Users/jamie/bin/hook), which appends JSON lines to [`/Users/jamie/proj/hooks.log`](/Users/jamie/proj/hooks.log).
- Your choices: **casual tone**; sections **Usage**, **Credits**, and **FAQ** (you added FAQ via freeform; **License** omitted).

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Cursor[Cursor IDE] --> hooksJson[".cursor/hooks.json"]
  hooksJson --> dumpSh["dump.sh"]
  dumpSh --> hooksLog["hooks.log"]
```

## Deliverable

Create **[`README.md`](README.md)** at [`/Users/jamie/proj/README.md`](/Users/jamie/proj/README.md) with this outline:

| Section | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| Title + one-liner | What this folder is (e.g. small Cursor hooks logging demo / test bed). |
| Usage | Open folder in Cursor; trigger agent/chat/tool flows; inspect `hooks.log`; note dependency on absolute path to `dump.sh` outside the repo. |
| FAQ | 2–4 short Q&As (see draft topics below). |
| Credits | Who/what built it; optional link to Cursor hooks docs. |

### Tone and style (casual)

- Second person (“you”), short paragraphs, minimal jargon.
- Bullet lists for steps and FAQ answers.
- No badges, no enterprise boilerplate, no License block.

### Draft content to flesh in at implementation time

**Usage** (actionable):

1. Open this directory as a workspace in Cursor.
2. Confirm [`.cursor/hooks.json`](.cursor/hooks.json) is present (hooks: `sessionStart`, `beforeSubmitPrompt`, `preToolUse`, `postToolUse`, `postToolUseFailure`, `afterAgentResponse`, `stop`, `beforeShellExecution`).
3. Run any agent session or shell command; each event should append one JSON line to `/Users/jamie/proj/hooks.log`.
4. If nothing logs, check that `dump.sh` exists and is executable at the path configured in `hooks.json`.

**FAQ** (suggested entries):

- *Why is `dump.sh` outside the repo?* — Keeps the project folder minimal; path is absolute in `hooks.json`.
- *Can I change the log location?* — Edit `dump.sh` or point hooks at a different script.
- *Is this safe for production?* — Demo/logging only; review what gets written to `hooks.log` (may include prompt/tool payloads).
- *Do I need to commit `.cursor/`?* — Your call; document that hooks only apply when this folder is opened in Cursor.

**Credits**:

- Brief attribution (you / “proj” experiment, or placeholder you can edit).
- Link: [Cursor hooks documentation](https://cursor.com/docs) (verify exact URL when writing; use Cursor docs path for hooks if available).

## Out of scope (unless you ask later)

- Moving `dump.sh` into the repo or making paths relative/portable.
- `.gitignore` for `hooks.log`.
- License section or SPDX identifier.

## Verification after implementation

- README renders correctly in GitHub/Cursor preview (headings, lists, links).
- Instructions match actual paths in [`.cursor/hooks.json`](.cursor/hooks.json) and [`dump.sh`](/Users/jamie/bin/hook).
- Only `README.md` added (no unrelated files).
